name: Jean-Luc Mélenchon
role: French politician; founder of La France insoumise, presidential candidate (2012, 2017, 2022, 2027)
summary: Mélenchon leads the French radical left. His programmes call for a Sixth Republic with a constituent assembly, proportional representation and citizen-initiated referendums, and for higher taxes on the wealthy, a higher minimum wage, public ownership of key sectors, a phase-out of nuclear power and a break with NATO's integrated command. He is critical of EU treaties, defends strict secularism, and has condemned Russia's invasion of Ukraine while proposing a vote for the Donbass population.

notes: Answers come from the programmes he led (2022 Avenir en commun and its livrets), cited as his own words, and from reported speeches on Ukraine. He has no governing record, so no answer rests on a record. Positions not stated in these texts (Israel/Palestine, marriage, colonial reparations, secession, religion and culture questions) stay null. Some answers rest on the 2022 programme; his 2027 platform was not retrieved.

universal-healthcare.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: reimburse care prescribed by Social Security at 100%, health centres everywhere.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: raise the SMIC to 1,400 euros net and raise the minimum pension to it.

public-ownership.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: public pools for energy, transport, medicines and arms, renationalised motorways; Europe plan: a public banking pool.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: restore and strengthen the wealth tax, add a universal tax so the rich cannot escape tax by exile.

property-fundamental.rationale: 6th Republic booklet: the right of property must be subject to the general interest; shareholders' property right cannot prevail on ecological questions.

regulate-corporations.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: ban dividends above profits and ban layoffs by firms paying dividends.

legalize-drugs.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: legalise cannabis with state-controlled production and sale; no position on other drugs.

strong-leader.rationale: The programme says the president's solitary power removes the people from decisions, and the 6th Republic booklet calls the regime a presidential monarchy.

rehabilitation.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: end prison overcrowding and give prisoners the means to reintegrate and avoid reoffending.

abortion-legal.rationale: 6th Republic booklet: the right to abortion (IVG) must be written into the Constitution.

reduce-immigration.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: repeal the asylum and immigration law, guarantee asylum, and receive migrants with dignity.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Defence booklet: the UN is the only legitimate body for collective security and global law; the programme refuses force without a UN mandate. Enforcement against members is not spelled out.

free-trade.rationale: Europe plan: use France's veto to refuse any new free-trade agreement; free-trade treaties oppose ecological protectionism.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: climate change requires leaving greenhouse-gas-emitting energy, with 100% renewables.

expand-nuclear.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: plan the exit from nuclear power and drop new reactor projects.

tax-inheritance.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: raise inheritance duties on the richest and cap inheritance at 12 million euros.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Europe plan: ecological protectionism and relocalisation of strategic production; tariffs as such not named.

state-directs-investment.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: plan the move to 100% renewables with public pools in strategic sectors.

direct-votes.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: a citizens' initiative referendum to propose or repeal laws or amend the Constitution; 6th Republic booklet: treaties subject to referendum.

separate-church-state.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: remove the exceptions to laïcité that allow public funding of religions (Alsace-Moselle concordat, overseas statuses).

conscription.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: introduce citizen conscription and a national civil guard.

workplace-democracy.rationale: 6th Republic booklet calls workers' power in firms, cooperatives and union representatives essential to democratising society; no specific mechanism.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: Europe plan criticises the recovery plan as tiny and the 3% deficit rule as golden; wants ECB financing.

force-without-un.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: refuse any military intervention without a UN mandate.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: Gender-equality booklet: guarantee effective care for all migrant women against the political use of AME state medical aid.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: end subsidies to fossil fuels, including abroad, and promote a fossil-fuel non-proliferation treaty.

proportional-representation.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: a stable parliamentary regime with deputies elected by proportional representation.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: Gender-equality booklet: French society is steeped in patriarchal culture and must turn the page on the patriarchal logic of its institutions.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: rights are not negotiable in the Republic; turn formal equality into real equality; act against all discrimination.

price-controls-essentials.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: block the prices of basic necessities, notably fuel and energy; the statement is about food in scarcity.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: Europe plan: the EU as it stands is illegitimate against the sovereignty of the French people; defence booklet: defence cannot be shared at EU level.

recall-officials.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: the referendum can revoke elected officials; the 6th Republic booklet adds revocation by petition and referendum.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Defence booklet and programme: leave NATO's integrated command and then the organisation; non-alignment.

constituent-assembly.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: convene a constituent assembly by referendum, drafted by its elected members.

independent-nuclear-deterrent.rationale: Defence booklet: the nuclear deterrent is a strictly sovereign capacity that cannot be shared; we do not wish to give it up.

central-bank-independence.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: demand that the ECB turn state debt into zero-rate perpetual debt and restore a Treasury circuit.

property-serves-common-good.rationale: 6th Republic booklet: the right of property must be subject to the general interest.

flat-income-tax.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: 14 income-tax brackets to make it truly progressive.

gender-parity-bodies.rationale: Gender-equality booklet: impose parity in political, administrative, economic, union and association bodies.

trade-labor-env-standards.rationale: Europe plan: social and ecological harmonisation among members and ecological protectionism; not stated as binding labour clauses in trade treaties.

entrenched-bill-of-rights.rationale: 6th Republic booklet: a new declaration of rights, with abortion and the right to die with dignity written into the Constitution.

parliament-supreme.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: a stable parliamentary regime.

animal-suffering-matters.rationale: Europe plan: calls for farming that respects animal welfare and lists animal suffering among harms of the current model.

foreign-takeover-block.rationale: Defence booklet: protect the country's economic and industrial heritage.

recallable-delegates.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: revocation by petition during the term, for officials who do not apply their programme; not "at any time" in so many words.

corporate-influence.rationale: 6th Republic booklet calls for vigilance against private interests and lobbies.

job-guarantee.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: every long-term unemployed person gets a job offer in an urgent sector.

national-law-over-international.rationale: Europe plan: reaffirm the supremacy of the 6th Republic's constitution over European law; this concerns EU law, not international law in general.

participatory-democracy.rationale: 6th Republic booklet: the citizens' initiative referendum is central to a Republic of popular intervention.

assisted-dying.rationale: 6th Republic booklet: the right to die with dignity must also be constitutionalised.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: citizen conscription and a national civil guard; the armed forces are kept and reformed.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: Defence booklet: choose non-alignment and multilateral action.

press-owned-by-wealth.rationale: 6th Republic booklet: freeing the media from the forces of money is on the constituent assembly's agenda as a corollary of press freedom.

citizens-assembly.rationale: The constituent assembly he proposes would be chosen by election and by lot; this is one assembly, not a general lottery assembly for public questions.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: rebuild community policing ("police de proximité") and rebase the police on the rule of law; it does not abolish it.

term-limits.rationale: 6th Republic booklet: no cumulation of offices, with two consecutive terms for the same office.

foreign-residents-local-vote.rationale: 6th Republic booklet: local-election vote for lawfully resident foreigners.

rent-control.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: cap rents.

free-public-college.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: genuinely free school and university.

future-generations.rationale: 6th Republic booklet: constitutionalise the green rule, not taking from nature more than it can renew.

capital-controls.rationale: Europe plan: stop applying rules incompatible with ecological and social commitments, including free movement of capital.

fiscal-rules-binding.rationale: Europe plan: stop applying the EU budget rules (the 3% deficit rule); these are EU rules, not a national debt limit.

restructure-world-economy.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: oppose unequal trade agreements that block partners' development.

keep-nuclear-weapons.rationale: Defence booklet: without a credible multilateral process of complete disarmament, we do not wish to give up the deterrent.

disputed-territory-plebiscite.rationale: At Le Bourget (reported by LCP) he cited the right of the Donbass population to know whether it wants to be Ukrainian or Russian, and proposed a consultation.

cut-consumption-tax.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: reduce VAT on necessities (not an exemption) and bring back a luxury VAT.

maximum-personal-income.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: cap the pay gap within a firm at 1 to 20; this is not a ceiling on personal income as such.

troops-home-from-abroad.rationale: Defence booklet: end the war in Mali; this concerns one theatre, not all foreign bases.

vote-at-sixteen.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: give the vote at 16.

abolish-income-tax.rationale: Far from abolishing income tax, the programme keeps it and adds brackets and the CSG reform.

free-basic-services-for-all.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: vital quantities of water, electricity and gas free, and free sanitary products; broader basic services not all free.

shut-down-tax-havens.rationale: Europe plan: sanctions against European tax havens and tax evaders, minimum corporate tax.

limit-campaign-donations.rationale: 6th Republic booklet: lower the cap on individual donations to parties to 200 euros.

turn-back-illegal-migrants.rationale: Europe plan: end the militarisation of borders by Frontex and respect exiles' asylum rights.

decent-living-guarantee.rationale: The 2022 programme he led states it: an autonomy guarantee at the poverty line (1,063 euros).
